recipes.title: Medjool Date Bark with Dark Chocolate & Peanut Butter

items.i: nuts of choice, chopped (pistachios shown; optional)

steps: Pulse the pitted dates in a food processor until they form a sticky paste, or flatten them by hand. Press into an even layer on a parchment-lined tray.
Spread the melted dark chocolate over the dates.
Drizzle with melted peanut butter, scatter with chopped nuts and finish with flaky sea salt.
Chill or freeze until firm, about 1 hour, then break into pieces. Keep in the fridge or freezer.
recipes.notes: Macros are the creator's approximate figures per piece; the number of pieces isn't given, so servings is estimated. Not low-calorie, as the creator says, but a minimally processed treat or pre-workout snack.
